protocol: Separate active-bound derivative policy, not a secant-width retry. Starting from centered-gradient32, joint box rows use saturated derivative if either projected argument is outside the box OR stored float32 impulse is already at/outside its exact float32 bound. No tolerance band, no physical projection change. This targets observed motor35 stored-at-bound but rounded-argument-interior discrepancy. Apply same approximation to local preconditioner and operator; other domains/contact derivatives unchanged. Original float64 outer residual/state/Armijo,128shared budget,Krylov settings,final gates remain. Approximate directions must pass original nonlinear merit. No parameter retry.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
(p/'center.py').write_text((p.parent/'rain-centered-gradient32/center.py').read_text())
derivative=(p.parent/'rain-centered-gradient32/derivative.py').read_text().replace("elif domain=='box':Dz=", "elif domain=='box' and b['original']['label'][0]=='joint':Dz,Dc=bound_state_derivative(y[ii],z,cap)\n  elif domain=='box':Dz=")
(p/'derivative.py').write_text(derivative)
source=(p.parent/'rain-local-preconditioner32/run.py').read_text()
source=source.replace("exec(compile(prefix,str(p/'direction.py'),'exec'))","exec(compile(prefix,str(p/'direction.py'),'exec'));exec(compile((p/'bound.py').read_text(),str(p/'bound.py'),'exec'))")
source=source.replace("elif domain=='box':Dz=","elif domain=='box' and dtype==np.float32 and b['original']['label'][0]=='joint':Dz,Dc=bound_state_derivative(y[jj],z,cap)\n  elif domain=='box':Dz=")
source=source.replace('source_part=split+rest',"exec(compile((p/'center.py').read_text(),str(p/'center.py'),'exec'));exec(compile((p/'derivative.py').read_text(),str(p/'derivative.py'),'exec'));source_part=split+rest")
exec(compile(source,str(p/'local.py'),'exec'))

center32=J32@m.vcap.astype(np.float32)+m.bias.astype(np.float32)+G32@m.old.astype(np.float32)
center64=m.J@m.vcap+m.bias+m.G@m.old
def centered_gradient(y,dtype):
 old=np.asarray(m.old,dtype=dtype);delta=np.zeros(m.offset,dtype=dtype);delta[r.remaining]=np.asarray(y,dtype=dtype)-old[r.remaining];center=center32 if dtype==np.float32 else center64;action=H32 if dtype==np.float32 else H;factor_list=factors32 if dtype==np.float32 else factors
 rhs=-(center+action(delta))[r.free]
 for ii,factor in factor_list:delta[r.free[ii]]=cho_solve(factor,rhs[ii])
 result=(center+action(delta))[r.remaining];assert result.dtype==dtype;return result
rngcenter=np.random.default_rng(20261011);cases=[('random-'+str(i),rngcenter.normal(size=r.N)) for i in range(24)]
for arm in ['cold','capped']:cases.append((arm,np.load(p.parent/'rain-projection-derivative32'/(arm+'.npz'))['impulses'][r.remaining]))
checks=[]
for label,y in cases:
 want=r.S@y+r.q;exact=centered_gradient(y,np.float64);new=centered_gradient(y,np.float32);old=Spre@y.astype(np.float32)+qpre
 checks.append(dict(case=label,algebra=float(max(abs(exact-want)/(1+abs(want)))),centered32=float(max(abs(new-want)/(1+abs(want)))),uncentered32=float(max(abs(old-want)/(1+abs(want))))))
assert max(v['algebra'] for v in checks)<=1e-9
(p/'center-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(records=checks),indent=2))
